dedupe_keys.name: isa 95 enterprise control system integration standard iec 62264

description: ISA-95 is an international set of standards for integrating enterprise business and logistics systems with manufacturing control systems. Its eight parts define a five-level hierarchy from the physical process (level 0) to business planning (level 4), models and terminology, objects and attributes for enterprise-control and manufacturing operations management, activity models, business-to-manufacturing transactions, messaging and alias service models, and information exchange profiles. It is published by the International Society of Automation and is also known as ANSI/ISA-95 and, internationally, IEC 62264. Coverage is global and applies to discrete, batch and continuous manufacturing; Part 1 was updated in 2025, Part 8 dates from 2020 and most other parts from 2013 to 2018. The documents are paid PDF standards sold by ISA, and members can view most standards read-only, so cost is paid. Caveat: it is a reference model, not data, and its terminology varies between vendor implementations of manufacturing execution systems. For simulation it structures digital twins and plant models, defining which production, maintenance and quality data flow between levels in optimisation and disruption studies. It is related to the OPC UA record in this catalogue, which covers device communication.
